global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: glossy pink gradient background, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, real aguaje fruits, a framed photo of a woman from behind in fitted clothing, clean thin-line icon modules and a rounded bottom offer bar.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; golden sunset light inside the photo, believable and natural.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pill banner and bottom bar in deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside white-outlined circles, soft translucent pink petal and heart outline shapes in the background corners, handwritten script accents with small drawn hearts, real aguaje fruits with a halved orange-flesh fruit.
global_identity.text_typography: Typography of the reference: heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / Poppins Black look), all uppercase, for the pill line, the second headline line, the icon labels and the bottom bar; the huge third headline word in fuchsia #E6177F with a thick white outline and a soft dark drop shadow, the largest text in the ad; casual handwritten brush script in deep magenta #B0105E, sentence case, for the two short emotional accents.

creative_objective: Reproduce the exact structure of the user's winning ad on a square canvas, adapted to this product, changing only the headline, the model, the place and the pose: the fitted dress she avoids today is waiting for her, shown in a real sunset photo, with the offer bar removing the fear of paying in advance.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: First the three-tier headline at the top (the huge outlined word 'ESPERANDO' dominates), second the product bottle in the center together with the framed sunset photo of the woman on the right, third the left icon column, the deep magenta offer bar at the bottom and the two script accents.
art_direction.composition_style: Top band: centered three-tier headline. Middle band split in three: narrow icon column on the left, product bottle center-left with aguaje fruits at its base, tall framed photo on the right. Bottom band: rounded offer bar from the left edge to about two thirds of the width, with a script accent in the bottom right corner.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: The headline uses about the top 30% of the canvas, the middle band about 55%, the bottom bar about 12%. Compact but airy spacing, everything aligned and readable on a phone; the bottle slightly overlaps the left edge of the photo frame zone without covering the woman.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft glossy pink gradient background, lighter in the center, with subtle translucent petal and heart shapes; the bottle lit with a soft studio key light and a gentle reflection, small contact shadow; the photo inside the frame has its own warm golden-hour sunset light with a soft rim light on the hair and shoulders.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Pink gradient background with faint translucent petal and heart outlines in the top corners. Top center: a deep magenta rounded pill with a white uppercase line; below it a big white uppercase line; below it one huge fuchsia uppercase word with a thick white outline and drop shadow. Left column, below the headline: three white thin-line icons inside white-outlined circles stacked vertically, each with a two-line white uppercase label below it. Center-left: the product bottle large and upright, with aguaje fruits (whole and one halved showing orange flesh) and green leaves at its lower left. Above the bottle to the right, a two-line handwritten script accent in deep magenta with a small drawn heart. Right side: a tall rounded-corner photo frame with a thin white border showing a woman from behind. Bottom: a deep magenta rounded bar from the left with a white truck icon and a white uppercase label, a thin white vertical divider, then a white hand-with-coin icon and a two-line white uppercase label. Bottom right corner, outside the bar: a two-line handwritten script accent in deep magenta.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium beauty-supplement image ad. Use the attached product photo as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle. Background: glossy pink gradient, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 to hot fuchsia #E6177F at the edges with a soft pale blush #FBE3EE glow in the center, faint translucent pink petal shapes and thin heart outlines in the top corners. TOP BAND (about 30% of the height), centered: a deep magenta #B0105E rounded pill containing a white uppercase heavy sans line; directly below, a big white uppercase heavy geometric sans line with a soft shadow; below it, one huge uppercase word in hot fuchsia #E6177F with a thick white outline and soft dark drop shadow, the largest text of the ad, spanning most of the width. MIDDLE BAND: on the far left, a narrow vertical column of three white thin-line icons, each inside a white-outlined circle, stacked with even spacing — a stylized rear glute silhouette with a small up arrow, a stylized leg silhouette, and a leaf — each with a two-line white uppercase bold label centered under it. In the center-left, large and upright, the product: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; the black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH', a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE', the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline, three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' at the bottom; sharp, soft studio light, small contact shadow. At the lower left of the bottle: real aguaje fruits (reddish-brown scaly whole fruits and one halved fruit showing bright orange flesh, #D9572B) with a few fresh green leaves. Above the bottle, to its right, a two-line handwritten brush script accent in deep magenta with a small drawn heart. On the right side, a tall rounded-corner photo frame with a thin white border, from just under the headline to just above the bottom bar: a photorealistic photo of a young Colombian woman with light brown (morena clara) skin and long straight loose black hair, seen from behind, wearing a short fitted bubblegum-pink bodycon dress, standing on a city apartment balcony with a slim black metal railing, a warm orange-and-lilac sunset sky and soft out-of-focus city buildings behind her; shot from behind at hip height, framed from the shoulders down to mid-thigh, she glances back over her shoulder so only a soft profile of her cheek and part of her face is seen, partly covered by her hair; natural athletic curves in glutes and legs, real skin texture, golden-hour rim light, tasteful and non-explicit. The dress is a slightly different, softer pink than the ad background so the photo stays clearly separated by its white border. BOTTOM BAND: a deep magenta #B0105E rounded bar from the left edge to about two thirds of the width, with a white delivery-truck line icon and a white uppercase label, a thin white vertical divider, then a white hand-holding-a-coin line icon and a two-line white uppercase label. In the bottom right corner, outside the bar, a two-line handwritten brush script accent in deep magenta with a small drawn heart. Everything clean, high contrast and readable on a phone. No other elements.
